scope: Real candidate learning/dictionary/core and shared vocabulary-store repository; two isolated Chromium pages, mocked dictionary/clipboard/storage transport; no network, installed extension, user profile or existing data.

cases.name: Two pages save distinct words through the real serialized repository without replacement
Concurrent note/mastered updates send only changed fields; dictionary updates preserve another page note
Revealed review note can be cleared, while an unrevealed note survives mastered marking
Clipboard includes definitions, source and licence; failure is visible
Actual candidate CSS allows real mouse selection under a user-select:none ancestor
Layer-specific language/context prevents a French translated word from being queried as English
A fresh word retains successful Chinese meanings when the English request reaches its real per-language timeout
Read failure blocks saving and requires a successful retry; existing words remain
Search and pagination reach old saved entries; refresh preserves unsaved draft text
Import versions 1–5 are previewed without writes; explicit merge retains existing notes and provenance
Invalid version, unsafe source, invalid entry, oversized file and too many entries cannot write
In-flight merge locks cancel and file changes; forced events cannot suppress the completion result
Single-item deletion requires the named confirmation, and cancellation preserves the record
JSON version 5 and CSV export preserve notes, context, timestamp, definitions and source/licence; replay remains intact
A legal 5000-entry vocabulary exports a >4 MiB JSON backup that restores into empty fixture storage
